rearticulation.text: Fix the recording figure's memory-overview placement, identify recording-only bottlenecks, evaluate Eli's PR stack first, and try minimal encoding or egglog-engine changes to bring recording/off runtime and peak RSS below 5× for every in-scope example using focused checks and timings during iteration.

paper.measurementBoundary: Whole-process wall time and peak RSS; proofs includes congruence and recording, excluding proof extraction and checking.

constraints: Evaluate existing PR-stack improvements before inventing a new optimization.
Identify measured bottlenecks before changing production code.
Prefer minimal proof-encoding or egglog-engine changes.
Use focused correctness checks and bounded timing runs during iteration.
Keep proof extraction/checking outside the performance target.
Preserve benchmark inputs, semantic work, cohort selection, and honest visibility of measurements outside the plotted range.

The earlier encoder-wide typed generation rewrite and a strongly typed Rust authoring API remain deferred. This goal optimizes the accepted source-generation/typechecking and runtime pipeline without introducing a new typed IR/binder or reviving PR #69.
